answer_text:
Most modern sales tools connect to Gmail; fewer have deep Slack integrations (deal alerts, approvals, slash commands). Good options:

1. Northwind CRM Revenue Cloud - excellent forecasting and territory tools, but setup usually needs a dedicated admin.
2. Halcyon Sales - combines cadences, dialer and pipeline in one place.
3. Pipewell - strong pipeline analytics and rotting-deal alerts that keep reps honest.

Pick Northwind CRM for breadth, or Halcyon Sales if you want something your reps will adopt faster.
